published.en: Mosaic club session. A participant is eligible exactly when their age is at least 16 and at most 80, they are not someone who is none of a resident, a student, and a member, and they are either at least 18 or have guardian consent. The submission instant must be no earlier than 2032-02-29T09:00:00.000Z and earlier than 2032-03-01T09:00:00.000Z; the opening instant is included and the closing instant is excluded. Apply fees only to admitted participants. A scholarship recipient pays nothing. Among people without a scholarship, every student pays $14 USD. Among the remaining people, members with guardian consent pay $9 USD; after that, remaining residents pay $16 USD; anyone still unmatched pays $31 USD. Each person receives only the first applicable price in that order. A scholarship does not waive any admission requirement. No other eligibility conditions or deadlines apply.
